clarified_summary: The acquiring bank retries settlement webhooks, so the same event can arrive more than once. Each event must credit the merchant's ledger exactly once.
assumptions: event_id is unique per bank event
the webhook signature check stays unchanged

acceptance_criteria.description: A webhook delivered twice with the same event_id credits the ledger once.
Concurrent duplicate deliveries credit the ledger once.
Replaying recorded traffic with duplicates leaves correct balances.

task_plan.description: Record processed event_ids with a unique key and credit only on first sight, inside one transaction.
Add a regression test for duplicate delivery.
